hell-kitchen.style.name: Hell's Kitchen
hell-kitchen.msg.intro1: §6The god "%s" declares: Hell's Kitchen begins! The first team to finish its sets wins.
hell-kitchen.msg.intro2: §7Check the set on your screen and drop finished dishes into your team's delivery hopper to score.
hell-kitchen.msg.intro3: §7Complete §f%s §7sets to win — or hold the highest score when time runs out.
hell-kitchen.msg.intro3.endless: §7This is §dEndless mode §7— keep clearing sets to keep scoring until time runs out; highest score wins.
hell-kitchen.msg.win: §6The god "%s" declares: %s§6finished its sets first and wins!
hell-kitchen.msg.burnt_delivered: §c"%s" shakes his head: this dish is burnt and scores nothing.
hell-kitchen.msg.dispenser_locked: §c"%s" locked the dispenser: it cannot be opened directly in this mode.
